# ============================================================
# 1) Build one HostSpecies color palette commun to 16s and ITS
#    (MANUAL fixed colors per HostSpecies)
# ============================================================

build_global_species_palette <- function() {

  fixed_colors <- c(
    "Bipectinata complex sp." = "#7B241C",
    "D. melanogaster"         = "#FFA500",
    "D. paulistorum"          = "#22427C",
    "Willistoni sp."          = "#1f9e89",
    "D. sturtevanti"          = "olivedrab",
    "Saltans sp."             = "darkgreen"
  )

  ordered_species <- names(fixed_colors)

  species_labels <- setNames(
    lapply(ordered_species, function(x) bquote(italic(.(x)))),
    ordered_species
  )

  list(
    colors = fixed_colors,
    ordered_species = ordered_species,
    species_labels = species_labels
  )
}

global_palette <- build_global_species_palette()

# ============================================================
# Helper : PERMANOVA pairwise for 1 factor
#   + Bonferroni correction on comparisons
# ============================================================
pairwise_permanova_one_factor <- function(dist_mat, grouping, nperm = 999) {
  grouping <- droplevels(as.factor(grouping))
  lev <- levels(grouping)

  if (length(lev) < 2) return(NULL)

  combs <- utils::combn(lev, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  res_list <- list()

  mat <- as.matrix(dist_mat)

  for (cmb in combs) {
    g1 <- cmb[1]
    g2 <- cmb[2]

    idx <- grouping %in% cmb
    sub_group <- droplevels(grouping[idx])

    tbl <- table(sub_group)
    if (any(tbl < 2)) next

    sub_dist <- as.dist(mat[idx, idx])
    sub_meta <- data.frame(group = sub_group)

    ad <- vegan::adonis2(
      sub_dist ~ group,
      data = sub_meta,
      permutations = nperm,
      by = "margin"
    )

    comp_name <- paste(g1, g2, sep = "_vs_")
    res_list[[comp_name]] <- ad
  }

  if (length(res_list) == 0) return(NULL)

  p_raw <- vapply(res_list, function(ad) {
    if (!"Pr(>F)" %in% colnames(ad)) return(NA_real_)
    rn <- rownames(ad)
    if ("group" %in% rn) {
      ad["group", "Pr(>F)"]
    } else {
      ad[1, "Pr(>F)"]
    }
  }, numeric(1))

  p_adj <- stats::p.adjust(p_raw, method = "bonferroni")

  for (i in seq_along(res_list)) {
    ad <- res_list[[i]]
    if (!"Pr(>F)" %in% colnames(ad)) next
    rn <- rownames(ad)
    if ("group" %in% rn) {
      ad["group", "Pr(>F)"] <- p_adj[i]
    } else {
      ad[1, "Pr(>F)"] <- p_adj[i]
    }
    res_list[[i]] <- ad
  }

  res_list
}

# ============================================================
# Utils: create a 16S dataset WITHOUT invasive pools (Category != "Invasive")
# ============================================================
make_16s_native_only <- function(infile, outfile = "Phyloseq_with_tree_16S_native_only.rds") {
  phy <- readRDS(infile)

  # Keep only Native pools (and drop empty taxa)
  phy_native <- phyloseq::subset_samples(phy, Category == "Native")
  phy_native <- phyloseq::prune_taxa(phyloseq::taxa_sums(phy_native) > 0, phy_native)

  saveRDS(phy_native, outfile)
  message("✅ Saved native-only 16S phyloseq to: ", outfile)
  outfile
}

# ============================================================
# 2) Unified analysis function
#    + optional plots (plot = TRUE/FALSE)
# ============================================================
analyze_phyloseq <- function(file, prefix,
                             marker = c("auto", "16S", "ITS"),
                             ordered_localities = c("Cayenne", "Kaw", "Bélizon", "Nouragues"),
                             global_palette = NULL,
                             root_16s_tree = TRUE,
                             verbose_rooting = TRUE,
                             nperm = 999,
                             make_plot = TRUE) {

  marker <- match.arg(marker)
  message("\U0001F4E6 Analyse : ", prefix)
  phy <- readRDS(file)

  if (marker == "auto") {
    if (grepl("16s", prefix, ignore.case = TRUE)) marker <- "16S"
    if (grepl("its|ol4", prefix, ignore.case = TRUE)) marker <- "ITS"

    if (marker == "auto") {
      has_tree <- !is.null(phyloseq::phy_tree(phy, errorIfNULL = FALSE))
      marker <- if (has_tree) "16S" else "ITS"
    }
  }

  permanova_results <- list(
    global = list(),
    category = list(),
    host = list(),
    dispersion = list(),
    pairwise = list()
  )

  meta <- as(phyloseq::sample_data(phy), "data.frame") %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID")

  meta$Locality <- factor(meta$Locality, levels = ordered_localities)

  present_species <- meta %>%
    dplyr::pull(HostSpecies) %>%
    as.character() %>%
    unique()

  # ---- palette (fixed colors, filtered to present species) ----
  if (!is.null(global_palette)) {

    ordered_species_present <- global_palette$ordered_species[
      global_palette$ordered_species %in% present_species
    ]

    colors <- global_palette$colors[names(global_palette$colors) %in% ordered_species_present]
    species_labels <- global_palette$species_labels[names(global_palette$species_labels) %in% ordered_species_present]

    missing_in_palette <- setdiff(present_species, ordered_species_present)
    if (length(missing_in_palette) > 0) {
      colors <- c(colors, setNames(rep("grey60", length(missing_in_palette)), missing_in_palette))
      species_labels <- c(
        species_labels,
        setNames(lapply(missing_in_palette, function(x) bquote(italic(.(x)))), missing_in_palette)
      )
      ordered_species_present <- c(ordered_species_present, missing_in_palette)
    }

    ordered_species <- ordered_species_present

  } else {
    ordered_species <- sort(present_species)
    colors <- setNames(rep("grey60", length(ordered_species)), ordered_species)
    species_labels <- setNames(lapply(ordered_species, function(x) bquote(italic(.(x)))), ordered_species)
  }

  meta$HostSpecies <- factor(meta$HostSpecies, levels = ordered_species)

  # ============================================================
  # Distances (+ plots if requested)
  # ============================================================
  if (marker == "16S") {

    # ---- midpoint rooting ----
    if (root_16s_tree) {
      tr <- phyloseq::phy_tree(phy, errorIfNULL = FALSE)

      if (is.null(tr)) {
        warning("No phylogenetic tree found in the phyloseq object -> cannot compute UniFrac.")
      } else {
        if (!ape::is.rooted(tr)) {
          tr_rooted <- phytools::midpoint.root(tr)
          phyloseq::phy_tree(phy) <- tr_rooted
          if (verbose_rooting) message("🌳 16S tree midpoint-rooted using phytools::midpoint.root()")
          permanova_results$rooting <- list(method = "midpoint.root (phytools)")
        } else {
          if (verbose_rooting) message("🌳 Tree already rooted -> keeping existing root.")
          permanova_results$rooting <- list(method = "already_rooted")
        }
      }
    }

    dist_list <- list(
      `UniFrac` = phyloseq::UniFrac(phy, weighted = FALSE, normalized = TRUE),
      `Weighted UniFrac` = phyloseq::UniFrac(phy, weighted = TRUE, normalized = TRUE)
    )

    # ---- Plot ONLY if requested ----
    if (make_plot) {

      if (!requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
        stop("Package 'patchwork' is required to combine UniFrac and Weighted UniFrac panels. Install it with: install.packages('patchwork')")
      }

      ord_list <- lapply(dist_list, function(d) phyloseq::ordinate(phy, method = "PCoA", distance = d))
      percent_var <- lapply(ord_list, function(o) round(100 * o$values$Relative_eig[1:2], 1))

      make_one_pcoa_plot <- function(dist_name, panel_title = NULL) {
        o <- ord_list[[dist_name]]

        df_one <- o$vectors %>%
          as.data.frame() %>%
          tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
          dplyr::select(SampleID, x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2) %>%
          dplyr::left_join(meta, by = "SampleID")

        xlab <- paste0("Axis 1 (", percent_var[[dist_name]][1], "%)")
        ylab <- paste0("Axis 2 (", percent_var[[dist_name]][2], "%)")

        ggplot2::ggplot(df_one, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y)) +
          ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = HostSpecies, shape = Locality), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
          ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = colors, labels = species_labels, drop = TRUE) +
          ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
          ggplot2::stat_ellipse(
            ggplot2::aes(group = Category, color = Category),
            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8, inherit.aes = TRUE
          ) +
          ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(Invasive = "orange", Native = "blue")) +
          ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
          ggplot2::theme(
            plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
            axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
            axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
            legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
            legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
          ) +
          ggplot2::labs(
            title = panel_title %||% dist_name,
            x = xlab,
            y = ylab
          )
      }

      p_unifrac <- make_one_pcoa_plot("UniFrac", panel_title = "UniFrac")
      p_wunifrac <- make_one_pcoa_plot("Weighted UniFrac", panel_title = "Weighted UniFrac")

      # Assemble side-by-side; keep one shared legend (HostSpecies/Locality/Category)
      # Assemble side-by-side; keep one shared legend (HostSpecies/Locality/Category)
p_core <- (p_unifrac | p_wunifrac) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right")

title_A <- patchwork::wrap_elements(
  full = grid::textGrob(
    "A",
    x = 0, hjust = 0,
    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 25, fontface = "bold")
  )
)

p <- title_A / p_core +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(0.06, 1))

      # keep the same output name as before
      ggplot2::ggsave(paste0("PCoA_UniFrac_", prefix, ".pdf"), plot = p, width = 10, height = 5)
      permanova_results$plot <- p
    }

  } else { # ITS

    dist_list <- list(
      `Bray-Curtis` = phyloseq::distance(phy, method = "bray"),
      `Jaccard`     = phyloseq::distance(phy, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
    )

    if (make_plot) {
      ord_list <- lapply(dist_list, function(d) phyloseq::ordinate(phy, method = "NMDS", distance = d))

      stress_vals <- sapply(ord_list, function(o) {
        if (!is.null(o$stress)) round(o$stress, 3) else NA_real_
      })

      facet_labels <- setNames(
        paste0(names(stress_vals), " (stress=", stress_vals, ")"),
        names(stress_vals)
      )

      df_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(ord_list), function(nm) {
        o <- ord_list[[nm]]
        o$points %>%
          as.data.frame() %>%
          tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
          dplyr::select(SampleID, x = MDS1, y = MDS2) %>%
          dplyr::left_join(meta, by = "SampleID") %>%
          dplyr::mutate(Distance = nm)
      })) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          Distance = factor(Distance, levels = c("Jaccard", "Bray-Curtis"))
        )

      p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_all, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y)) +
        ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = HostSpecies, shape = Locality), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
        ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = colors, labels = species_labels, drop = TRUE) +
        ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
        ggplot2::stat_ellipse(
          ggplot2::aes(group = Category, color = Category),
          linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8, inherit.aes = TRUE
        ) +
        ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(Invasive = "orange", Native = "blue")) +
        ggplot2::facet_wrap(~Distance, scales = "free", labeller = ggplot2::labeller(Distance = facet_labels)) +
        ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
        ggplot2::theme(
  plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"),
  strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
  legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
  legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
        ) +
        ggplot2::labs(
          title = "B",
          x = "NMDS1",
          y = "NMDS2"
        )

      ggplot2::ggsave(paste0("NMDS_Jaccard_Bray_", prefix, ".pdf"), plot = p, width = 10, height = 5)
      permanova_results$plot <- p
    }
  }

  # ============================================================
  # PERMANOVA (global + pairwise) + BETADISPER (each distance)
  # with guards for factors with <2 levels (e.g., Category in native-only)
  # ============================================================
  for (nm in names(dist_list)) {
    cat("\n🔎 ", nm, " PERMANOVA - ", prefix, "\n", sep = "")

    # ---- drop unused levels ----
    meta$HostSpecies <- droplevels(as.factor(meta$HostSpecies))
    meta$Locality    <- droplevels(as.factor(meta$Locality))
    meta$Category    <- droplevels(as.factor(meta$Category))

    n_host <- nlevels(meta$HostSpecies)
    n_loc  <- nlevels(meta$Locality)
    n_cat  <- nlevels(meta$Category)

    permanova_results$global[[nm]] <- list()

    if (n_host >= 2 && n_loc >= 2) {
      permanova_results$global[[nm]]$Host_Locality <-
        vegan::adonis2(dist_list[[nm]] ~ Locality * HostSpecies,
                       data = meta, by = "terms", permutations = nperm)
      print(permanova_results$global[[nm]]$Host_Locality)
    } else {
      permanova_results$global[[nm]]$Host_Locality <- NULL
      message("⚠️ Skip Host_Locality: need >=2 levels for HostSpecies and Locality")
    }

    if (n_loc >= 2 && n_cat >= 2) {
      permanova_results$global[[nm]]$Locality_Category <-
        vegan::adonis2(dist_list[[nm]] ~ Category * Locality,
                       data = meta, by = "terms", permutations = nperm)
      print(permanova_results$global[[nm]]$Locality_Category)
    } else {
      permanova_results$global[[nm]]$Locality_Category <- NULL
      message("⚠️ Skip Locality_Category: need >=2 levels for Locality and Category")
    }

    if (n_host >= 2) {
      permanova_results$global[[nm]]$Host <-
        vegan::adonis2(dist_list[[nm]] ~ HostSpecies,
                       data = meta, by = "margin", permutations = nperm)
      print(permanova_results$global[[nm]]$Host)
    } else {
      permanova_results$global[[nm]]$Host <- NULL
      message("⚠️ Skip Host: HostSpecies has <2 levels")
    }

    if (n_loc >= 2) {
      permanova_results$global[[nm]]$Locality <-
        vegan::adonis2(dist_list[[nm]] ~ Locality,
                       data = meta, by = "margin", permutations = nperm)
      print(permanova_results$global[[nm]]$Locality)
    } else {
      permanova_results$global[[nm]]$Locality <- NULL
      message("⚠️ Skip Locality: Locality has <2 levels")
    }

    permanova_results$pairwise[[nm]] <- list(
      HostSpecies = if (n_host >= 2) pairwise_permanova_one_factor(dist_list[[nm]], meta$HostSpecies, nperm = nperm) else NULL,
      Locality    = if (n_loc  >= 2) pairwise_permanova_one_factor(dist_list[[nm]], meta$Locality,    nperm = nperm) else NULL
    )

    permanova_results$dispersion[[nm]] <- list()

    if (n_cat >= 2) {
      bd_cat <- vegan::betadisper(dist_list[[nm]], group = meta$Category)
      permanova_results$dispersion[[nm]]$Category <- anova(bd_cat)
      cat("\n📏 ", nm, " BETADISPER(Category) - ", prefix, "\n", sep = "")
      print(permanova_results$dispersion[[nm]]$Category)
    } else {
      permanova_results$dispersion[[nm]]$Category <- NULL
      message("⚠️ Skip betadisper(Category): Category has <2 levels")
    }

    if (n_host >= 2) {
      bd_host <- vegan::betadisper(dist_list[[nm]], group = meta$HostSpecies)
      permanova_results$dispersion[[nm]]$HostSpecies <- anova(bd_host)
      cat("\n📏 ", nm, " BETADISPER(HostSpecies) - ", prefix, "\n", sep = "")
      print(permanova_results$dispersion[[nm]]$HostSpecies)
    } else {
      permanova_results$dispersion[[nm]]$HostSpecies <- NULL
      message("⚠️ Skip betadisper(HostSpecies): HostSpecies has <2 levels")
    }

    if (n_loc >= 2) {
      bd_loc <- vegan::betadisper(dist_list[[nm]], group = meta$Locality)
      permanova_results$dispersion[[nm]]$Locality <- anova(bd_loc)
      cat("\n📏 ", nm, " BETADISPER(Locality) - ", prefix, "\n", sep = "")
      print(permanova_results$dispersion[[nm]]$Locality)
    } else {
      permanova_results$dispersion[[nm]]$Locality <- NULL
      message("⚠️ Skip betadisper(Locality): Locality has <2 levels")
    }
  }

  return(permanova_results)
}

# ============================================================
# 5) Export ALL PERMANOVA + pairwise PERMANOVA + BETADISPER into ONE Excel
#    + keep R2 (PERMANOVA only)
#    + NOW includes res_16s_native_only
# ============================================================

extract_full_tests <- function(obj, source_name) {
  results <- list()

  recurse <- function(x, path = character()) {
    if (inherits(x, "anova") && "Pr(>F)" %in% colnames(x)) {

      df <- as.data.frame(x)
      df$term <- rownames(df)

      Df_col <- if ("Df" %in% colnames(df)) "Df" else NA_character_

      SS_col <- dplyr::case_when(
        "SumOfSqs" %in% colnames(df) ~ "SumOfSqs",
        "Sum Sq"   %in% colnames(df) ~ "Sum Sq",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )

      R2_col <- if ("R2" %in% colnames(df)) "R2" else NA_character_

      F_col <- dplyr::case_when(
        "F"       %in% colnames(df) ~ "F",
        "F value" %in% colnames(df) ~ "F value",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
        row <- df[i, ]
        orig_term <- row$term

        if (orig_term %in% c("Residual", "Model", "Total")) next

        is_pairwise <- any(path == "pairwise")

        if (is_pairwise && length(path) >= 4) {
          factor_name <- path[3]
          comparison  <- path[4]
          term_label  <- paste0(factor_name, ":", comparison)
        } else {
          term_label <- orig_term
        }

        results[[length(results) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
          source = source_name,
          level1 = path[1], level2 = path[2], level3 = path[3],
          level4 = path[4], level5 = path[5], level6 = path[6],
          Term = term_label,
          Df = if (!is.na(Df_col)) row[[Df_col]] else NA_real_,
          SumOfSqs = if (!is.na(SS_col)) row[[SS_col]] else NA_real_,
          R2 = if (!is.na(R2_col)) row[[R2_col]] else NA_real_,
          F = if (!is.na(F_col)) row[[F_col]] else NA_real_,
          p_value = row[["Pr(>F)"]],
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }

    } else if (is.list(x)) {
      for (nm in names(x)) recurse(x[[nm]], c(path, nm))
    }
  }

  recurse(obj)
  dplyr::bind_rows(results)
}

format_tests_table <- function(df_all) {

  df_all <- df_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(!Term %in% c("Residual", "Model", "Total")) %>%
    dplyr::select(-Df, -SumOfSqs, -F)

  df_all <- df_all %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      source = dplyr::case_when(
        source %in% c("res_16s", "res_16S", "res16s") ~ "bacteriome",
        source %in% c("res_its", "res_ITS", "res_OL4", "res_ol4") ~ "mycobiome",
        source %in% c("res_16s_native_only", "res_16S_native_only") ~ "bacteriome_native_only",
        TRUE ~ source
      ),
      Dataset = paste(source, level1, sep = " - "),
      Test = dplyr::case_when(
        level1 == "dispersion" ~ "Betadisper",
        level1 == "pairwise"   ~ "Permanova_pairwise",
        TRUE                   ~ "Permanova"
      )
    )

  df_all <- df_all %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Dataset = dplyr::case_when(
        Dataset %in% c("bacteriome - global", "bacteriome - dispersion", "bacteriome - pairwise") ~ "bacteriome",
        Dataset %in% c("mycobiome - global", "mycobiome - dispersion", "mycobiome - pairwise")   ~ "mycobiome",
        Dataset %in% c("bacteriome_native_only - global", "bacteriome_native_only - dispersion", "bacteriome_native_only - pairwise") ~ "bacteriome_native_only",
        TRUE ~ Dataset
      )
    )

  df_all <- df_all %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Distance = level2,
      RawModel = level3
    )

  df_all <- df_all %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      RawModel = dplyr::case_when(
        RawModel == "Additive"           ~ "Locality + HostSpecies",
        RawModel == "Interaction"        ~ "Locality X HostSpecies",
        RawModel == "Host"               ~ "HostSpecies",
        RawModel == "Host_Locality"      ~ "HostSpecies X Locality",
        RawModel == "Locality_Category"  ~ "Locality X Category",
        TRUE ~ RawModel
      ),
      Model = paste(Distance, RawModel, sep = " ~ ")
    )

  df_all %>%
    dplyr::select(Dataset, Model, Test, Term, R2, p_value) %>%
    dplyr::rename(`P-value` = p_value) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      R2 = dplyr::if_else(Test == "Betadisper", NA_real_, R2)
    )
}

filtrer_groupes_modeles <- function(df_group) {
  df_x <- df_group %>% dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(Model, "X"))

  if (nrow(df_x) >= 2) {
    n_signif <- sum(df_x$`P-value` < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (n_signif >= 2) {
      return(df_x)
    } else {
      df_group <- df_group %>% dplyr::filter(!stringr::str_detect(Model, "X"))
    }
  }

  if (any(stringr::str_detect(df_group$Model, "\\+"))) {
    df_group <- df_group %>% dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(Model, "\\+"))
  }

  df_group
}

# ---- extract + combine + format ----
df_16s_raw <- extract_full_tests(res_16s, "res_16s")
df_its_raw <- extract_full_tests(res_its, "res_its")
df_16s_native_raw <- extract_full_tests(res_16s_native_only, "res_16s_native_only")

df_all_raw <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_16s_raw, df_its_raw, df_16s_native_raw)
df_formatted <- format_tests_table(df_all_raw)

df_perm      <- df_formatted %>% dplyr::filter(Test == "Permanova")
df_pairwise  <- df_formatted %>% dplyr::filter(Test == "Permanova_pairwise")
df_disp      <- df_formatted %>% dplyr::filter(Test == "Betadisper")

df_perm_filtered <- df_perm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(variable_expliquee = stringr::str_trim(stringr::str_extract(Model, "^[^~]+"))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Dataset, variable_expliquee) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ filtrer_groupes_modeles(.x)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-variable_expliquee)

df_filtered <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_perm_filtered, df_pairwise, df_disp) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Dataset, Test, Model, Term)

View(df_filtered)
writexl::write_xlsx(df_filtered, path = "Permanova_ordination.xlsx")
